scope: X12 and X14 trial guidance fixes with X15 dual-account verification

implementation.member_guide: Owned platform-token selection via the existing model-list API; only model and public endpoint returned. CPR uses current-origin Responses/input; ordinary unambiguous OpenAI channels keep Chat/messages.
implementation.route_panel: Reads existing approved source by stable node identity; withdrawn node shows paused sending, failed source reads show unconfirmed state, and saved exit information is labelled as a previous observation.

environment.services: real New API, CPR, PostgreSQL, two Redis instances and Mihomo in isolated Compose
environment.upstream: constructed OAuth and model responses through two independent private proxy nodes
environment.browser: Chromium 149 with a trusted isolated TLS issuer

verified: Two separately authorized accounts and two member groups each complete concurrent JSON and SSE using the expected account label and socket peer
Two TLS WebSocket sessions retain their own account and egress over two native continuation turns
Withdrawing node A sends no A generations while member B still succeeds; approving A again restores later successful calls
Approving a new version of node A preserves the account's published historical version and actual old peer
Actual browser-copied Responses command completes with confirmed usage; credentials are passed privately to the verifier
Owned-token request examples keep the existing model array; another user's token ID is rejected; internal credentials are absent
A CPR-only ungranted key receives an empty example; an ordinary OpenAI-only key receives the Chat endpoint
Browser route detail shows a withdrawn-node warning and historical observation; injected source-read failure shows unconfirmed state and refresh recovers the view
390-pixel route dialog has no page-width overflow
Both member totals equal recorded consumption
remaining: Official third-party login and public upstream accounts or nodes
Named production client versions and long-duration load
Public distribution, production deployment and X17 maintenance exercises
